title: DR1 explains what a CPH number is and where to find one; the frontend CPH page offers no explanation at all.

finding.frontend: The page is a heading, an example hint and a text box. A trader who does not know what a County Parish Holding number is, or does not know where to look one up, is given nothing (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/cph-number/template.njk:5-26). The only help is the format example in the hint.
finding.prototype: Between the heading and the field DR1 puts a closed disclosure, "What is a CPH number?" (app/views/cph-number.html:44-51). Opening it gives two things: what the number is — "a unique 9-digit number used to identify land and buildings where livestock are kept, moved or handled" — and where to get it, on documents from the Animal and Plant Health Agency or by checking the holding details on GOV.UK, the second offered as a link.
finding.difference: Add the same disclosure above the CPH field with both paragraphs. The GOV.UK link is a placeholder in DR1 and needs a real destination before this ships, so agree the target with content design as part of the change rather than after it.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding any guidance about what a CPH number is, or where to find one, anywhere on the frontend CPH page or on the consignment addresses row that leads to it.

relatedTo.why: both change the CPH page and would be built in one visit to it
